notes: The current card's classification task and TSK scope are supported, but its single module conflates three separately described mechanisms and uses retired dimensions and an incorrect mapped view. The original ID is retained for the hierarchical reasoning procedure. The blind work-role judgment is revised under literal R0: L477-L491 prescribe four stages; pruning changes the candidate and feature inputs, without evidence that returned feedback changes which stage executes next. Thus fixed_workflow is better supported than feedback_driven_agent. No LLM-side training is contributed; frozen encoders, FAISS and AutoGluon are not counted as standalone contributions. Temporal validity denotes experimental timestamp alignment and exclusion of alignment anomalies only; no chronological cutoff guarantee is claimed. Intermediate candidate-retention scores and token/latency measurements do not establish execution validity, and HAR labels/rationales are not downstream decision utility.

changes: Split the composite module into offline pairwise profiling, class-wise multi-sensor retrieval, and hierarchical activity reasoning; retain the existing ID for the reasoning procedure.
All three modules remain TSK with time_series_classification as an other task.
Replace retired dimensions with Planning and Orchestration for within-instance selection and pruning; assign Memory and Context and Tools and Execution to the separately described mechanisms.
Correct view_status from mapped to task_procedure; record module-specific temporal functions, empty llm_route, and complete reuse evidence.
reconciliation.reason: L303-L314 and L440-L446 describe an independently constructed pairwise knowledge registry; L457-L476 and L492-L500 describe class-conditioned placement retrieval and synchronized rank fusion; L477-L491 describe their consuming four-stage reasoning procedure. Separate component ablations at L1286-L1313 further support distinct mechanisms. Each embeds a classification objective under R3_1_TSK. Pruning controls the current classification episode, with no evidence of reusable cross-episode optimization.
